build_PedestalModel: build a PedestalModel instance with formation and saturation models to calculate pedestal temperature and density
evaluate_pedestal: evaluate pedestal properties given runtime params, geometry, core profiles, source profiles, and transition state
call_PedestalModel: call a PedestalModel instance to compute pedestal output or return defaults when set_pedestal is false
implement_PedestalModel: implement the abstract _call_implementation method to define pedestal property calculations for a concrete model
combine_transport_multipliers: combine formation and saturation transport multipliers via exp(log) for numerical stability in ADAPTIVE_TRANSPORT mode
